reference.pathophysiology: Topical therapy works when quantity, potency, vehicle and site match: fingertip units dose by area, superpotent steroids serve thick palmoplantar skin briefly while mild agents with calcineurin-sparing classes serve face and folds, and emollient soak-and-seal underpins eczema care. Systemic classes step in for extensive, blistering or pustular disease with organ monitoring, while narrowband UVB and PUVA calm psoriasis and vitiligo with eye and dose review. Procedures follow depth: punch for blister level and tumours with perilesional DIF, shave for exophytic benign lesions, cryotherapy for warts and actinic spots, curettage-electrodesiccation for selected low-risk trunks, and Mohs for critical-site basal cell cancer.
